name: Greedy Meshing with Block Type Masking
aliases: Greedy meshing with multiple block types
definition: A modification of greedy meshing that groups adjacent voxels into single quads only if they share the same block type and orientation, allowing for distinct textures or materials on merged faces.
summary: Greedy Meshing with Block Type Masking groups adjacent voxels into quads only if they share the same block type and orientation, preserving visual distinctions between materials while maximizing mesh optimization.
